purpose: Kanji paper variations for visual comparison

assets.label: A · White hanshi
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: blank Japanese calligraphy paper background texture for the Niwa kanji learning page.
Create a sleek, refined, beautiful sheet of authentic Japanese calligraphy paper viewed exactly straight down, filling the entire image. Landscape 1536x1024. This is a usable subtle background material for large black brush-font kanji overlaid programmatically. The texture must remain understated enough that black brush strokes and small dark UI text stay extremely clear.
One single opaque full-bleed blank paper texture with finely resolved tactile fibers and soft natural watercolor-compatible material character. Uniform soft diffuse lighting, even tone across the whole surface, no dramatic light. Make it seamlessly repeatable in both directions, with matching edge colors and similar texture density at the top, bottom, left and right.
No visible sheet edges, no table, no paper stack, no deckled outline, no frame, no folds, no creases, no wrinkles, no aged stains, no foxing, no yellowed edges, no corner details, no vignettes, no shadows, no diagonal illumination, no clouds drawn as pictures, no illustrations, no marks, no speckles resembling dirt, no text or calligraphy, no seal, no grid lines, no watermark. Paper only.
The material should feel smooth, serene, contemporary and premium, while retaining a barely visible natural fibrous texture.
Material variation: White hanshi direction: luminous warm off-white around #f7f5ee, very fine evenly dispersed paper tooth, compact softly pressed short fibers nearly invisible at normal UI viewing scale. The cleanest and sleekest choice; tactile only on close inspection. Light warm-white with very little tonal variation.
